headline: The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority on Thursday dismissed a notification circulating on social media about an alleged TikTok ban as fake, saying no such notification has been issued, Dawn reports.

card.desc: PTA: TikTok ban ka koi notification jari nahi hua

caption:
TikTok ban ki khabar jhooti nikli!
Dawn ke mutabiq PTA ne Thursday ko bataya ke social media par TikTok ban ka jo notification gardish kar raha hai woh jaali hai, aur aisa koi notification jari nahi kiya gaya. PTA ne awam ko kaha ke sahi maloomat sirf PTA ki official website aur verified social media accounts se lein.
Kya aap ne bhi yeh fake notification dekha tha? Comment mein batayein 👇
